Hi Asha / Tom -

Thanks again for a great discovery today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can build a mutual action plan (MAP) that matches your buying process:

- Win criteria we heard: reduce per-call inference cost by ~40% for high-volume flows, keep 95th latency < 300ms, and maintain data residency in us-west.
- Stakeholders noted on the call: you (Asha) as project lead, Tom for procurement, security/legal TBD, and engineering contacts for integration (you mentioned a couple of SREs).

Can you confirm the primary economic buyer and the security/procurement contacts (name + email)? Also: what is your internal procurement review timeline (typical number of weeks)?

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll draft a MAP with milestones (technical eval, security questionnaire, procurement review, pilot).
2) Share draft MAP + MAP workbook by EOD Thu (I'll attach an editable MAP).
3) We get a short technical Q&A with your SREs (30 min) next week to validate integration work.

I've CC'd our SE (Dev Patel) and solutions engineer (Nikhil Sharma) so they can join the technical session and start the paperwork for the security review.

Thanks - let me know if I missed anything.

Best,
Marissa
